headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 5, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 25.82%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.87%. This results in an average alpha of 11.95%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top-performing portfolio, 'Random A,' achieved a return of 48.13%, contributing positively to the overall portfolio performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' returned 18.93%, still above the SPY but less impactful. This outperformance during the year-to-date period highlights the portfolio's resilience amid broader market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
